title: Temperature scale
prompt: Implement nested class `Solution.Temperature`: constructor `(double celsius)` throws `ArgumentException` below absolute zero (-273.15, exact boundary allowed); read-only `Celsius`; static factory `FromFahrenheit(double f)` converting with C = (F − 32) × 5⁄9 and applying the same validation after conversion.

tests.name: normal
tests.hint: The conversion is (F − 32) × 5⁄9 — check both anchor points.

tests.name: validation
tests.hint: −273.15 exactly is legal; anything lower throws — via the constructor OR after conversion.
